title: SRE-01 Workshop — Agents vs EDOT
description: Side-by-side logs, metrics, and traces: Fleet-managed Elastic Agent (ECS / System integration) vs EDOT collector (OTel-native via Managed OTLP).

config.content:
## Elastic Agent (Fleet) vs EDOT collector

**Left:** Fleet-managed Elastic Agent on `aks-sre-01` .. `03` — System integration, **ECS**, ingest pipelines, `logs-system.*` / `metrics-system.*`. **Right:** EDOT collector → Managed OTLP — **OTel semantic conventions**, `*.otel-*` streams, ingest pipelines skipped.

These are not interchangeable: different streams, mappings, and on-call runbooks. Fleet System does **not** emit traces; EDOT does.

data_source.query: FROM logs-system.auth-*, logs-system.syslog-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE host.name IN ("aks-sre-01", "aks-sre-02", "aks-sre-03") | STATS count = COUNT(*)
FROM metrics-system.* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE host.name IN ("aks-sre-01", "aks-sre-02", "aks-sre-03") | STATS count = COUNT(*)

config.content:
**Agent traces: none**

System integration collects logs + host metrics only. Traces need an OTel/APM input on the policy.

data_source.query: FROM logs-*.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*)
FROM metrics-*.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*)

FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.`service.name` IN ("well-data-api", "telemetry-gateway", "identity-service", "rig-scheduler") | STATS count = COUNT(*)

config.content:
### Elastic Agent — logs (ECS)
`logs-system.auth-*` / `logs-system.syslog-*` · parsed by the System ingest pipeline (`event.action`, `process.name`, `user.name`).

### EDOT — logs (OTel)
`logs-*.otel-*` · body + `resource.attributes.service.name` · **no** ECS ingest pipeline. Includes app logs and OTLP syslog (`rsyslog`).

data_source.query: FROM logs-system.auth-*, logs-system.syslog-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE host.name IN ("aks-sre-01", "aks-sre-02", "aks-sre-03") | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), host.name
FROM logs-*.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), resource.attributes.`service.name`

FROM logs-system.auth-*, logs-system.syslog-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE host.name IN ("aks-sre-01", "aks-sre-02", "aks-sre-03") | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY process.name
FROM logs-system.auth-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE event.outcome IS NOT NULL | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY event.outcome
FROM logs-*.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY resource.attributes.`service.name`
FROM logs-*.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY severity_text

config.title: Agent logs by process and action

data_source.query: FROM logs-system.auth-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY process.name, event.action, event.outcome | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 20

config.title: EDOT logs by service and severity

data_source.query: FROM logs-*.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY resource.attributes.`service.name`, severity_text | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 20

config.content:
### Elastic Agent — host metrics (ECS)
`metrics-system.*` from Metricbeat receivers. CPU / memory of the agent containers (`aks-sre-01` .. `03`).

### EDOT — app metrics (OTel)
`metrics-workshop.otel.otel-*` · `http.server.request.total` as **counter** documents (cannot SUM; count of datapoints). Plus APM summary streams in `metrics-*.otel-*`.

data_source.query: FROM metrics-system.cpu-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE host.name IN ("aks-sre-01", "aks-sre-02", "aks-sre-03") | STATS cpu = AVG(`system.cpu.total.norm.pct`) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), host.name

config.title: EDOT HTTP request datapoints by service

data_source.query: FROM metrics-workshop.otel.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE metrics.`http.server.request.total` IS NOT NULL | STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), resource.attributes.`service.name`

config.title: Agent memory used pct by host

data_source.query: FROM metrics-system.memory-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE host.name IN ("aks-sre-01", "aks-sre-02", "aks-sre-03") | STATS mem = AVG(`system.memory.actual.used.pct`) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), host.name

FROM metrics-workshop.otel.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE metrics.`http.server.request.total` IS NOT NULL | STATS requests = COUNT(*) BY resource.attributes.`service.name` | SORT requests DESC

config.content:
### Elastic Agent — traces

**Not collected** on policy `sre-01-workshop`.

The System integration ships host logs and metrics through Beat receivers into ECS data streams. Distributed traces require:

1. An **OpenTelemetry** input package on the same Fleet policy (preview), or
2. EDOT / Managed OTLP (right-hand column).

That gap is the operational lesson: adding traces later is a **new stream + new runbook**, not a toggle on these system dashboards.

data_source.query: FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.`service.name` IN ("well-data-api", "telemetry-gateway", "identity-service", "rig-scheduler") | STATS spans = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), resource.attributes.`service.name`

FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.`service.name` IN ("well-data-api", "telemetry-gateway", "identity-service", "rig-scheduler") | STATS spans = COUNT(*) BY name | SORT spans DESC | LIMIT 12

config.title: EDOT spans by service and name

data_source.query: FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.`service.name` IN ("well-data-api", "telemetry-gateway", "identity-service", "rig-scheduler") | STATS spans = COUNT(*) BY resource.attributes.`service.name`, name | SORT spans DESC | LIMIT 20
